name: Kho ca loc chien mam me
nameVi: Khô cá lóc chiên mắm me
summary: Dried snakehead fried and finished with tamarind fish sauce. The center calls that sauce sour and hot, and says the plate goes with rice. A price is Check on arrival.
origin: A plate of khô cá lóc from the Đồng Tháp Mười part of Tây Ninh, on the provincial tourism center's drying-yard article. Not lunch at the Holy See.
taste: Fry the dried fish and add mắm me. Sour, hot, and meant for rice. A fuller recipe was not printed.
howToEat: Order it where dried snakehead is cooked. The article does not name a restaurant.
A price is Check on arrival. The hour is Check on arrival.
where: The drying yards are along kênh 79 and at the markets named for khô cá lóc. A table for this plate was not given its own address. The center also points at orchard and countryside tourism spots.
